"The child-side app of KidsLink Kids is a parental control application that requests Accessibility Service permission. Its purpose is to assist in authorizing the child-side app and to help prevent uninstallation or disabling of the app. For example, when entering the app management page, if it detects the child-side app, it will display a warning to prevent such actions. We do not collect any private data from pages without the parent's knowledge."

"The child-side application of KidsLink Kids is a parental control app that requests background location permissions to ensure continuous location tracking, even when the app is running in the background. This feature allows the parent-side application to monitor the child's location in real time, providing a layer of safety and protection. Importantly, the location data is exclusively accessible through the parent-side application and is not shared or used in any other context."

"To help parents manage their child's screen time, we need to access and upload the list of apps installed on this device so that parents can remotely control app usage.
This data is only used for parental control features and will not be used for advertising or shared with third parties.
Do you agree to allow us to collect this information?"
